title: ToolTest 40 - Command Palette and Radial Menu

courses.title: ToolTest 40 - Command Palette and Radial Menu
courses.objective: Find tools quickly through Ctrl+K and the context-sensitive radial menu, including radial-menu customization.

steps.title: Open command search
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Find a Wave tool
steps.instructions: Search for Gumball, Offset face or another registered Wave tool.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Launch from search
steps.instructions: Run the selected command from search.
steps.expectedResult: The selected command executes from the palette.

checkpoint.expected: The selected command executes from the palette.

validationChecks: Command executes without switching to an empty ribbon tab
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Open radial menu
steps.expectedResult: The radial menu appears around its invocation point.

checkpoint.expected: The radial menu appears around its invocation point.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Run a radial command
steps.instructions: Choose one radial slice appropriate to the current selection.
validationChecks: Selected slice invokes its mapped tool
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, restore the reference selection, and repeat the step with the listed inputs.

steps.title: Customize radial slices
steps.instructions: Open customization and change one slice mapping.
steps.expectedResult: The selected slice uses the new mapping on the next open.

checkpoint.expected: The selected slice uses the new mapping on the next open.

validationChecks: Custom configuration is retained during the session
